Name: OpenWave
Description: Control OpenWave's mixes from a Stream Deck.

systems.garcia.openwave.mixlevel.Name: Mix Volume
systems.garcia.openwave.mixlevel.Tooltip: Master volume of one OpenWave mix. Press to mute.

systems.garcia.openwave.sourcelevel.Name: Source Volume
systems.garcia.openwave.sourcelevel.Tooltip: Trim of one microphone or source, in every mix at once. Press to mute.

systems.garcia.openwave.sendlevel.Name: Source Level per Mix
systems.garcia.openwave.sendlevel.Tooltip: One source's level inside a single mix, leaving every other mix alone. Press to mute.

systems.garcia.openwave.micgroup.Name: Mic Group
systems.garcia.openwave.micgroup.Tooltip: Hand a microphone group over to its next microphone.

systems.garcia.openwave.scene.Name: Scene
systems.garcia.openwave.scene.Tooltip: Recall an OpenWave scene; optionally hold to save the current state into it.

systems.garcia.openwave.fxtoggle.Name: Effect Toggle
systems.garcia.openwave.fxtoggle.Tooltip: Flip a microphone's low cut, gate, compressor or mono, with an LED for its state.

systems.garcia.openwave.outputtoggle.Name: Output Toggle
systems.garcia.openwave.outputtoggle.Tooltip: Switch a mix between output devices, e.g. speakers and headphones. Shows which one is live.

Localization.key.scene.title: Scene
Localization.key.output.title: Output
Localization.pi.start_openwave: Start OpenWave, then reopen this panel.
Localization.pi.level.stack: Stack more targets (tap the strip to cycle)
Localization.pi.level.hint: Rotate to adjust, press to mute.
Localization.pi.level.hint.mix: A mix's master. It moves everything routed into the mix and everything capturing from it at once, and works whether OpenWave is running or not.
Localization.pi.level.hint.source: A source's trim, applied ahead of the per-mix faders, so it moves that source in every mix at once. Needs OpenWave running.
Localization.pi.level.hint.send: One source's level inside a single mix. Every other mix is left alone, which is what separates this from Source Volume. Needs OpenWave running.
Localization.pi.level.choose_pair: Choose a source and a mix.
Localization.pi.level.nothing_configured: OpenWave has nothing of this kind configured yet.
Localization.pi.level.needs_openwave: OpenWave is not running, and this action needs it.
Localization.pi.level.needs_openwave_send: OpenWave is not running, and this action needs it: a source's level inside one mix is OpenWave's own state.
Localization.pi.level.only_mixes: OpenWave is not running, so only mixes can be listed. Start it to choose a source or a send.
Localization.pi.level.system_output_warning: This mix is the system output. Muting it silences everything, not just OpenWave.
Localization.pi.micgroup.label: Microphone group
Localization.pi.micgroup.hint: Press the key to hand the group over to its next microphone. Only one microphone in a group is live at a time; microphones in other groups are left alone.
Localization.pi.micgroup.how: Group two microphones in OpenWave first: drag one row onto the middle of another.
Localization.pi.scene.label: Scene
Localization.pi.scene.hint: Press the key to recall the scene — every trim, send, mute, output, master and device setting it holds.
Localization.pi.scene.hold: Hold the key (~1s) to save the current state into this scene
Localization.pi.scene.how: Save a scene in OpenWave first: the camera menu in the header bar, “Save current as…”.
Localization.pi.fx.hint: Press the key to flip the effect in that microphone's DSP chain. The LED shows whether it is currently in the chain; thresholds are set in OpenWave (the FX popover, or Auto-calibrate).
Localization.pi.output.hint: Each press moves the mix to the next output in the list, skipping any device that is unplugged. The key shows the live one. Two is the usual pair; the extra slots are optional.
Localization.pi.output.unsupported: This OpenWave can't switch outputs remotely yet. Update it; the key works as soon as it can.
